import json, random, sys
rnd = random.Random(7)
# Max streaming: 40000 steps, 3 attempts each = 120000, Q=16, L=8, R=32, epoch=1
Q, L, R = 16, 8, 32
U = 2**31
borders = [0] + sorted(rnd.sample(range(1, U), R-1)) + [U]
steps = []
t = 0
nid = 0
for k in range(40000):
    t += 1
    lanes = rnd.sample(range(L), 3)
    arr = [{"id": "p%d" % nid, "lane": ln, "rank": rnd.randrange(U)} for ln in lanes]
    nid += 3
    rnd.shuffle(arr)
    steps.append({"t": t, "serve": True, "arrivals": arr})
req = {"mode":"stream","banks":Q,"lanes":L,"limit":U,"borders":borders,
       "capacity":20000,"epoch":1,"steps":steps}
open("big_stream.json","w").write(json.dumps(req))

# Max burst: 120000 packets
packets = [{"id":"b%d"%i,"lane":rnd.randrange(L),"rank":rnd.randrange(U)} for i in range(120000)]
req2 = {"mode":"burst","banks":Q,"lanes":L,"limit":U,"borders":borders,
        "start_bank":0,"packets":packets}
open("big_burst.json","w").write(json.dumps(req2))

# Worst-case idle burst: all packets in one bank far from start_bank
Q2 = 16
packets2 = [{"id":"c%d"%i,"lane":0,"rank":U-1} for i in range(120000)]
# lane 0, range R-1 -> pointer (R-1+0)%Q2 ; make them all go to bank 15 by choosing L=1
req3 = {"mode":"burst","banks":Q2,"lanes":1,"limit":U,"borders":borders,
        "start_bank":0,"packets":packets2}
open("big_idle.json","w").write(json.dumps(req3))
print("sizes:", len(open("big_stream.json").read()), len(open("big_burst.json").read()))
PYEOF
python3 genbig.py && ls -la big_*.json
